verifiedLocally: The actual instrumented observer creates parent and Host Origins on one memory filesystem; its exact staged Host request feeds the actual instrumented Host/control creator in the same operations and clock namespace.
Control cannot be claimed before successful original upstream parent and Host reference ACK and sender cleanup.
Admission binds exact source/request/argv/job/tag/nonce, original control generation, parent identity, upstream operations/clock/retention and destination peer/challenge.
The control hop has a new one-shot window of at most 20 seconds within unchanged global retention; completed upstream delivery cannot be refreshed and source execution deadlines are not extended.
Original retained control FD is used after source cleanup and unlink without consulting an obsolete dynamic scope adapter or reopening its path.
Cancellation before delivery or during opaque claim, send or ACK cannot record a successful control receipt.
Wrong or lost ACK is terminal; source-close errors are sticky and unknown descriptors are not retried after descriptor-number reuse.
Late ACK descriptors after cancellation are retired once, and late close uncertainty invalidates cached successful close.
Each upstream/control observation first merges all admitted Origin/Store watermarks; deterministic rollback after transfer validation is rejected before send, including the upstream parent path.
Caller retains ownership of unprepared Origins and borrowed channels; receiver leases remain independently owned after sender shutdown.
